chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a muhrim when he needs various different kinds of clothing. So he, peace be upon him, said: "For each type of them, there is a fidyah upon him."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.فِدَاءٌ: an expiation or compensatory offering due for a violation

ai.seo_question: What expiation must a muhrim give if he wears different kinds of clothing out of need?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in the state of ihram who needs to wear different kinds of clothing. The Imam عليه السلام states that an expiation is due for each distinct type of clothing worn, showing the detailed legal consequences of violating ihram restrictions.
